prompt.default: Draw a route from home to the station that passes the school and the library.

backdrop.$comment: The SVG text of the map, with a layer of paths the candidate can follow; empty: the example map

poi.$comment: JSON: name → point number, e.g. {"start":125,"end":342}; "start" is where the route begins. Empty: none (the example map has its own)

label.en: Id of the path layer in the SVG
label.nl: Id van de laag met paden in de SVG

label.en: Points of interest on the map
Points of interest the route must pass
label.nl: Plaatsen waar de route langs moet

requiredpoi.$comment: Names from data-poi, comma separated; the route must pass all of them. Empty, with no end and not shortest: no score

label.en: Point of interest the route must end at
label.nl: Plaats waar de route moet eindigen

endpoi.$comment: A name from data-poi; empty: the route may end anywhere

label.en: The route must be a shortest one
label.nl: De route moet een kortste zijn

shortest.$comment: No longer than the shortest way from the start, past the required points (any order), to the end

label.en: Language of the buttons and messages
label.nl: Taal van de knoppen en meldingen
